description:
>>>

Demolisher v1.21

<<<

This mod should be fully compatible with all other mods as it only adds new ships to the game.

Many of the ships are an extensive modernization of existing ones.

From time to time I will update my little mod - basically, after each update to the core game, or if I think of something I really wanted to change or add.

There are no extra weapons added to this mod, and I don't plan to add any in the future.
